summary: Mock report, written without a model call. It exercises every field of the security review schema so the export, storage and rendering paths run end to end.

findings.title: Mock: a release asset installs at the latest version
findings.description: Mock finding. The release is resolved to whatever is latest at install time.
findings.impact: A compromised upstream release reaches the machine on the next install.
findings.remediation: Pin the release to a version and verify its published checksum.

findings.title: Mock: shell startup files are replaced by symlinks
findings.description: Mock finding. The install links shell startup files into the home directory.
findings.impact: The EDR may alert on shell configuration changes.
findings.remediation: Tell the security team before installing so the alert is expected.

conditions: SEC-001: pin the release and verify its checksum before installing.
